title: Pocket Fuel Menthol Mist Shortfill E-Liquid 50ml
description: Menthol Mist is an exquisite e-liquid from Pocket Fuel that offers a premium clean, crisp menthol base laced with the sweet punch of garden-fresh peppermint for a deliciously refreshing all-day vape experience. These shortfill bottles contain 50ml of nicotine-free liquid, with 10ml of extra space within the bottle to accommodate your nicotine shot of choice. This allows you to create a liquid with your own desired nicotine strength, and typically adding a 10ml nicotine shot to a 50ml shortfill will give you 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. Once you have added your preferred amount of nicotine, make sure you shake the contents of the shortfill bottle well. We also offer a range of 18mg nicotine-containing e-liquid shots in a variety of VG percentage strengths to ensure you find a perfect match to suit your taste.
